about: Where the berth codes in the southern pilots' daily plan (pilotcosouth.vn, HCMC area) are. Codes are matched after normalising: upper case, parenthesised qualifiers such as (NR), (NL), (NEO), (MR) removed, a trailing NR/NL removed, numbers without leading zeros. Each entry is a terminal-level location: the centre of the named OpenStreetMap feature, not the individual quay. 'confidence' says how the code was tied to the place: 'name' when the code is the terminal's own name or abbreviation, 'likely' when it rests on a naming convention that the plan itself does not confirm. Codes not listed here are left unplaced on purpose -- they include buoy berths, anchorages, oil and cement berths, and shipyard docks whose locations were not established.
